verdict.rationale: Docs describe a dedicated non-billable Test Drive sandbox with full API access, test banks (FinBanks) and test payroll provider (FinPayroll), and multiple 'testing personas' representing different user profiles for exercising linking (via Connect) and data retrieval scenarios, plus a GitHub sample project that generates a client library from the spec for realistic integration testing. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of test credentials/login details for the test institutions and explicit coverage of simulated error states (e.g., failed auth, MFA challenges) in the sandbox.
